description: Configurable planning policy for formal research preparation. These values seed the plan and can be changed without editing Python.

source_hints_by_area.market_size_growth: official statistics, industry association, broker/consulting report, market data provider
source_hints_by_area.demand_customer_logic: customer/end-user/end-market research, industry report, channel/platform/user data
source_hints_by_area.industry_structure: industry report, company filings, broker report, value-chain analysis
source_hints_by_area.key_trends_drivers: industry report, regulator/standard body, technology report, broker report, M&A news
source_hints_by_area.competitive_landscape: company filings, industry report, peer disclosures, market data provider
source_hints_by_area.competitive_dynamics: industry report, company disclosures, broker report, trade media with cited data
source_hints_by_area.transaction_relevance_context: peer transactions, investor commentary, sector reports, selectively labeled project context

source_specific_hints.market_size_growth: official statistics, industry associations, regulatory or sector reports
source_specific_hints.demand_customer_logic: company filings, company calls/transcripts, user or purchaser research
source_specific_hints.industry_structure: industry reports, value-chain studies, financial filings
source_specific_hints.key_trends_drivers: industry report, regulator/standard body, M&A and company announcements
source_specific_hints.competitive_landscape: company filings, peer filings, transaction updates
source_specific_hints.competitive_dynamics: financial results, M&A databases, strategic announcements
source_specific_hints.transaction_relevance_context: peer transactions, sector commentary, selectively labeled project context

default_source_hint: industry report, company disclosure, official or authoritative source

deep_search.rationale: Core pitch issue: run multiple actual searches when possible, ideally authority/source-specific plus reconciliation/counter-check.

light_search.rationale: Supporting issue: run one actual search when material, or account for why it is not material/available.

accounting_only.rationale: Coverage-audit row: execute only if material after scoping; otherwise account for it as not_material or not_executed in formal execution.

research_request_queue.authoring_rule: Reasoning LLM writes research_request_queue.json directly only for evidence that is required before promoting a claim. Do not generate requests mechanically from every open question.
research_request_queue.build_rule: No builder script owns this artifact. Use LLM authoring plus pipeline.py validate for mechanical structure only.
